name: 2023-04-20 — hybrid solar eclipse, geocentric greatest eclipse
source_notes: NASA GSFC identifies this as a hybrid solar eclipse and publishes the instant of greatest eclipse as 04:16:44.8 UT. This regression checks the geocentric greatest-eclipse epoch only; the expected_eclipse_type field records the source's event classification and is not a computed classification at every location. NASA's published Besselian realization uses VSOP87/ELP2000-85 and Delta-T=70.3 s; EclipseKit's configured DE440s realization may differ slightly, so the 30-second tolerance is a screening threshold, not a universal accuracy claim.
